author: @lisafiets
text:
There were Naver articles published about SEVENTEEN on how what makes them standout from the industry is that they never changed: they still perform as if they're rookies, with just as much drive and passion. Too often senior artists become complacent over time because of their status and popularity, but SEVENTEEN is different in that their performance level has remained consistent throughout their entire career, AND constantly improving and being fine-tuned.They declare it themselves quite often too, that they hope they will never lose that "rookie mindset", and it really does show in everything they do: from their humility, their welcoming openness to their fellow Kpop idols of all generations, their active involvement in all aspects of their career, the way they practice and perform as hard as if they're just about to debut next month.
Their professionalism and discipline in their craft, coupled with the sincerity of their artistry and the joyful energy they have as a group, shows all the more starkly here in their Rock With You choreography. The passion and love for what they do—and their undying commitment to their Carats—is exactly what this performance is all about.

author: @Hyunawol
text:
(최)승철 - 보스, 행동 : 작전 나갈 때 같이 나가서 보스인지 모르는 타조직 많을 듯, 무표정으로 한 방 컷

윤정한 - 오른팔, 딜러 : 웃으면서 약점 잡고 협박 잘할 듯

홍지수 - 스파이, 뒷처리 : 스파이로 다른 조직 잠입해서 넘길 거 다 넘긴 후에도 그 조직원인 마냥 있다가 세븐틴이 처들어오면 돕는 척 하면서 뒤에선 같이 공격할 듯

문준휘 - 행동 : 단거리로 본인에게 불리할 듯한 구도 만들어놓고 다 끝장내는 악취미 있을 듯

권순영 - 행동 : 무기보다는 몸으로 공격하면서 급소 부분 노릴 듯

전원우 - 작전 : 해킹실에 처박혀서 심심할 땐 아무 조직이나 걸리는 데로 다 털어버릴 듯, 주위에 누구 있으면 산만하다고 혼자서 작전짜고 지휘까지 다 할 듯

이지훈 - 행동 : 얘는 저 멀리 건물 어딘가 숨어서 저격할 듯, 거리가 아무리 멀어도 헤드샷만 쏠 듯

서명호 - 행동, 딜러 : 딜러로는 그냥 무표정으로 다 씹어먹을 거 같고 행동으로는 중장으로 다 씹어먹을 듯. 생채기 하나 없이 오는 거 잘할 거 같음

김민규 - 스파이, 행동 : 얘는 홍지수한테 전격으로 스파이 짓 맡기고 기밀 문서 같은 거 찾아서 넘길 듯, 행동은 장검으로 다 쓸어버릴 듯.

이석민 - 행동 : 얘는 온리 건으로 모든 건이란 건은 다 섭렵할 듯, 애용하는 건 가장 불리한 권총인데 이유는 상대가 벌벌 떠는 모습이 보고 싶어서일 듯 (얘도 악취미임)

부승관 - 지원 : 차에서 대기 타다가 도움 필요할 때 나타나서 한 방에 끝내버릴 듯, 지원인 이유는 흰 옷 좋아하는데 피 튀기는 거 싫어서일 듯

최한솔 - 행동 : 이지훈처럼 저격하는데 이지훈이랑 실력 비슷할 듯, 근데 얘는 장검도 잘 써서 필요에 따라서 들어갈 듯

이찬 - 행동 : 얘도 중장인데 뭔가 어리바리한 느낌으로 상대가 김장 풀게 만든 다음에 어느 정도 적정 거리 되면 무표정 지은 다음 쓸어버릴 듯

옷 입은 거로 캐해 해봄
(007이 뭔지 잘은 모르지만 조직 느낌인 거로 알고 있어서) 조금 예민할 수도 있는 부분이라 무기 같은 건 웬만해선 안 적으려고 해봄 (쩔수 없는 부분은 조금 두리뭉실하게 적었어요)

Seventeen is famous for their synchronization and self-producing group. Just watch any synchronization analysis video, svt would almost always be no 1. author: @vindicatedtruth
text:
A computer algorithm once concluded that SEVENTEEN is the most synchronized idol group in the industry (even across generations), with almost a 96% accuracy, which is as humanly close to perfection as possible.

Synchronization is no joke especially for a group of 13 members, because that's thirteen times the chance of having mistakes, and yet there's no other group currently in the industry who executes that knife-life synchronization the way they do. Once you get to observe for yourself the "SEVENTEEN STANDARD" in performing, you'll start to view other performances by other idols by that standard, and realise just how almost impossibly high SEVENTEEN has set it for the industry to follow. 

And yet what makes the dance practice behind videos such those on INSIDE SEVENTEEN all the more important to reveal is because that standard of near-perfection doesn't come easy. It comes with the absolute discipline in honing even the littlest details in their choreography—down to the angle of their arms and the timing of their gestures—and as they clearly demonstrate in those behind-the-scenes: practicing even to the point of absolute exhaustion.

It's the kind of reverence and respect that only SEVENTEEN can inspire, because even after seven years in the industry, and ten years practicing together since pre-debut, they have never let themselves be complacent in their craft.

SEVENTEEN is the standard of performance because they set it so highly, first and foremost, for THEMSELVES.

author: @baegosopa9391
text: I ran the numbers generated by the computer algs and also found that the "complexity" of the choreography did not significantly correlate with their synchronization. Basically, it does not matter how many formation changes, individual movements, etc. that the dance has, they are ALWAYS in sync.

author: @vindicatedtruth
text:
@@baegosopa9391 not to mention that it means all 13 of them are all strong dancers and are relatively on the same performance level, for them to dance with a knife-sharp synchronicity like this. I feel like it’s taken for granted that there are a lot of incredible dancers in the industry—which is true—but within groups, there’s a clear disparity between the “dancers” and “non-dancers”, as in: you can clearly see that some members are better dancers than others.

That isn’t really the case with SEVENTEEN. Sure, the performance team can be seen as relatively more “competent” than the other teams, in that they can also easily freestyle and choreograph, but in terms of dance skill, the other 9 members aren’t really that “behind”, and all of them can clearly hold their own when given the spotlight.

SEVENTEEN is one of the few groups who DON’T have a center, and rightly so, because even when you look at their ever changing formations, ALL of them can rightly hold the spotlight in performance, because ALL of them are THAT GOOD.

author: @baegosopa9391
text: @@vindicatedtruth The fact that you wrote up another conclusion based off of the analysis is so amazing that I'm happy giggling. You're absolutely right. I have about 10ish years in dance. With choreos that change formations and centers as often as Seventeen's, the quality of the performance can only be be as good as the weakest dancer. No way to hide it. Another thing I've noticed about Seventeen is that they give their all in each performance. You can kinda tell with other dance-heavy groups their choreos become more simple as time since their debut grows, or that the dancers who are not in the center tend to weaken their movements later in the song. Look at 2:48. EVERYONE. HITTING. THEIR. BODY ROLL. This is after hours of filming and singing LIVE.

That allows the leader S.COUPS to sing with his soft voice leading up to the climax of this intense rock-based song: “Nothing can be taken for granted, because you’re the only one I got.” The entire team, seven years into their career, renewed their contracts with their agency ahead of the expiration and declared that the love they receive is not to be taken for granted. author: @vindicatedtruth
text:
There were Naver articles published about SEVENTEEN on how what makes them standout from the industry is that they never changed: they still perform as if they're rookies, with just as much drive and passion. Too often senior artists become complacent over time because of their status and popularity, but SEVENTEEN is different in that their performance level has remained consistent throughout their entire career, AND constantly improving and being fine-tuned.

They declare it themselves quite often too, that they hope they will never lose that "rookie mindset", and it really does show in everything they do: from their humility, their welcoming openness to their fellow Kpop idols of all generations, their active involvement in all aspects of their career, the way they practice and perform as hard as if they're just about to debut next month.

Their professionalism and discipline in their craft, coupled with the sincerity of their artistry and the joyful energy they have as a group, shows all the more starkly here in their Rock With You choreography. The passion and love for what they do—and their undying commitment to their Carats—is exactly what this performance is all about.

author: @vindicatedtruth
text:
@@masterping548 this was actually my favorite excerpt from the recent Weverse article:

"Seven years into their debut, the team still practices to the point of exhaustion and runs about with glee when they’re satisfied with their on-point performance. “Rock with You” incorporated the elements of SEVENTEEN’s practice room vibes into a performance, which now has become CARAT’s pride and joy. In this regard, the performance of “Rock with You” looks like a sequence from a musical about SEVENTEEN themselves. From WONWOO’s ending in “Pretty U” five years ago till he takes charge of the ending of "Rock with You,” they still practice like their lives depend on it to bring their performance to another level. That allows the leader S.COUPS to sing with his soft voice leading up to the climax of this intense rock-based song: “Nothing can be taken for granted, because you’re the only one I got.” The entire team, seven years into their career, renewed their contracts with their agency ahead of the expiration and declared that the love they receive is not to be taken for granted. This is the mark of an idol group."
